description: If you've been searching for a 2010 Hyundai Genesis Coupe 3.8 Track for sale in Hayward, CA, your search ends here. Import Auto World has this rear-wheel-drive sport coupe in stock and ready for a test drive  a genuine driver's car at a price that makes sense for the East Bay market.About This 2010 Hyundai Genesis Coupe 3.8 Track At 109,582 miles, this Genesis Coupe sits squarely in the sweet spot for a used sports coupe  broken in, but with plenty of life left when maintained properly. The Track trim represents the top of the Genesis Coupe lineup for the 2010 model year, meaning this car left the factory loaded with the performance hardware serious drivers actually want. This is not a base-model coupe dressed up with badges  the 3.8 Track is the real deal, and finding one in Alameda County is becoming increasingly rare as these cars get snapped up by enthusiasts who know what they're worth.2010 Hyundai Genesis Coupe Performance and Engine3.8-Liter V6 Power The heart of this coupe is Hyundai's 3.8-liter Lambda V6, producing around 306 horsepower and 266 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission with Shiftronic manual control, this setup gives you the flexibility of convenient daily driving alongside the ability to take manual control when the road opens up.
